tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search published venues by name or description, optionally filtered by city, cuisine, price band, neighbourhood, whether the venue takes reservations, proximity (near a lat/long within a radius, nearest first) and opening hours (open on a given day/time, or open now) — all HARD filters that exclude

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have at least one published venue.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get one published venue's summary, capabilities and live mcp_endpoint by its slug.

tools.name: get_venues
tools.description: Get several published venues' summaries in ONE call by their slugs — the batch counterpart to get_venue, so a shortlist from search_venues needs no per-slug round-trip; the base view (identity, essentials, capabilities, booking, mcp_endpoint) is always returned, while include opts into heavier per-v

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Search published travel destinations by name; omit the query to list all, and connect to each result's mcp_endpoint for its listings, events and guides.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published venues and destinations together in one call, each result tagged with its kind (venue or destination); pass kind to scope to one type, query to match names and venue descriptions, and city to narrow venues, then use search_venues or search_destinations for type-specific filters such

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: Get one published destination's summary and live mcp_endpoint by its slug.

tools.name: search_menus
tools.description: Search menu items across all published venues by text, city, required dietary tags and allergens to avoid, each result tagged with its venue so an agent can rank venues in one call.

tools.name: facet_vocabulary
tools.description: The closed facet vocabulary (vibe, cuisine, dietary, and more) plus today's live cuisine, price_band and neighbourhood values across published venues, the exact values search_venues' matching filters accept.

tools.name: venue_profile
tools.description: Get a named venue's published profile summary — give its name (and city) or slug.

tools.name: venue_menu_search
tools.description: Search a named venue's menu by text, required dietary tags and allergens to avoid; call venue_dietary_options first for the exact spellings.

tools.name: venue_dietary_options
tools.description: List a named venue's declared dietary tags and allergens — the exact spellings venue_menu_search matches literally.

tools.name: venue_faq
tools.description: Search a named venue's published FAQs, optionally filtered by text.

tools.name: venue_links
tools.description: Get a named venue's published booking and other links (connect to its mcp_endpoint to actually book).

tools.name: destination_overview
tools.description: Get a named destination's summary: counts by category, currency, timezone.

tools.name: destination_facets
tools.description: List a named destination's valid area, category and tag filter values.

tools.name: destination_listings
tools.description: Search a named destination's listings by text, category, area and tags (slugs from destination_facetsty and more. Pass topic (from destination_overview guide_topics) to read one subject; page with cursor.

tools.name: destination_faq
tools.description: Answer a question about a named destination from its published FAQs; omit query to read them all.

tools.name: destination_offers
tools.description: Find a named destination's current deals and packages, with the partner booking link. Only offers valid on valid_on (today by default) are returned. Offer booking_url when present; cite canonical_url, the destination's page.

tools.name: destination_seasonality
tools.description: Get a named destination's best time to visit, weather and wildlife seasons (e.g. whale watching), month by month.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: search

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: fetch

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_venues" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search published venues by name or description, optionally filtered by city, cuisine, price band, neighbourhood, whether the venue takes reservations, proximity (near a lat/long within a radius, nearest first) and opening hours (open on a given day/time, or open now) — all HARD filters that exclude " → after: "Find restaurants and bars by city, cuisine, opening time or features. Filters are HARD, prefer_* and avoid are SOFT (rank only), and query is ONE keyword. Each result has slug, capabilities, open_now and distance_km; a place inside a destination is not here, use destination_listings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
